headline: Wingtech Rejects Nexperia Restructuring Plan, Citing Discrimination
summary: Shanghai-listed Wingtech Technology rejected a restructuring proposal that would strip it of control over Dutch chipmaker Nexperia's assets outside China, condemning the plan as expropriation.
why: Cross-border technology disputes highlight geopolitical tensions over semiconductor supply chains and foreign ownership of critical industrial assets.

impacts.name: Wingtech Technology
impacts.why: Wingtech is the parent company rejecting the restructuring proposal for Nexperia's non-Chinese assets.
